industries.narrative: Near-universal breadth (96% up) and strong +2% cap-weighted move, but light relative volume suggests technical drift rather than fresh institutional accumulation.
Narrow but powerful — storage names (SNDK, WDC, STX) and AI-server plays (DELL, ANET) driving +2.8% move while half the group lags. Stock-picker's tape.
AI/data-center power infrastructure theme — VRT, BE, HUBB, POWL leading. Decent breadth (71%) and solid magnitude, but volume conviction notably absent.

sector_breadth_notes.note: Tech leadership is the dominant theme, with both semicap (broad) and hardware (narrow, storage/AI-server) qualifying. Two of three qualifying industries are inside XLK.
Industrial strength is exceptionally narrow — only Electrical Equipment (AI power infra) qualifies while Aerospace, Tools, Waste, and Distribution are deep laggards. Sector move is a single theme.
Financials sector signal is hollow — no industry qualifies and all insurance sub-industries (Specialty, P&C, Life) plus Mortgage Finance are bottom-decile laggards.
Materials sector lacks an industry driver — Gold and Agricultural Inputs are among the weakest groups today. Sector qualification appears to be noise.
No utilities industry crossed the 6.5 score gate; sector strength is diffuse rather than concentrated in a tradeable sub-industry.

key_divergences: Sharp split inside Industrials: AI-power infra (Electrical Equipment) leads while Aerospace, Tools, Waste, and Distribution collapse. Financials shows reverse — sector ETF qualifies but every insurance sub-industry is a laggard, suggesting mega-cap bank distortion.
